title: Your page is saved, themes that match their designs, and a helper in the corner
notes: Your page is saved on this device as you go — close ArcMe, sign out or update, and it’s all still there.
A little robot in the corner: tap it to ask the helper anything in your own words; drag it wherever it’s out of the way.
All six themes use their own artwork now, with dark themes on a dark page.
The book fills its pages: a short day’s photo grows to fill the page instead of sitting in a corner.
Search finds what you wrote, not just captions — and no longer matches every day.
On a computer there’s a Search button, and dark themes now colour the whole window.
